final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as exam_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), stats AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total_exams, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM group_counts) SELECT gc.ID, gc.exam_count, CAST(gc.exam_count AS REAL) / s.total_exams as fraction, (CAST(gc.exam_count AS REAL) / s.total_exams) - (1.0 / s.num_groups) as excess FROM group_counts gc, stats s WHERE (CAST(gc.exam_count AS REAL) / s.total_exams) > (1.0 / s.num_groups) ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
